concepts.name: Command Bastion
concepts.direction: Closest to current Armored Command: continuous paired armored pillars, heavy square gunmetal frames, octagonal corner bolts, worn olive-brass bevels, restrained molten-orange seam lights, vertically stacked sturdy wells. Clear continuous outer silhouette.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: Bullets of Fury side HUD concept art, a matched LEFT and RIGHT vertical HUD column shown side by side on one transparent canvas. Use the reference solely for material, bevel, orange lamps, dark blue-black display wells and Neo-Geo arcade pixel finish. This is a new SIDE HUD, not the old horizontal top/bottom strips. Output 1024 x 1536 pixels, even dimensions, orthographic perfectly flat front view, no perspective. Exactly two separate tall columns, left occupies x=16..496 and right x=528..1008, all visible with narrow transparent padding. The outside and the gap between columns must be genuinely transparent. Keep every screen well dark opaque blue-black, flat and empty, no text or symbols, since the real game's readable type and icons will be overlaid. This is only authored metal housing art; no ships, no gameplay, no logo, no icons, no numbers, no letters.
Required well layout, approximate pixel positions within EACH 480-wide column, matching on all variants:
LEFT: score screen x=40,y=60,w=400,h=176; two separate square maneuver bays side by side, x=40 and250,y=282,w=190,h=190, each with a small horizontal meter trough near its bottom; large square equipped-weapon display x=40,y=524,w=400,h=400; two horizontal auxiliary bar displays x=40,y=972 and1068,w=400,h=64; a pilot/status screen x=40,y=1154,w=400,h=274.
RIGHT: square radar screen x=40,y=60,w=400,h=400; square special-ability screen x=40,y=506,w=400,h=400 with a narrow meter trough at its bottom; two square stock counter bays side by side x=40 and250,y=950,w=190,h=190; large lock-on screen x=40,y=1186,w=400,h=242. Square side boxes and side bars, clean visually readable wells, the framing must respect every reserved screen area. Keep proportions and bevels consistent. Retain the reference's dark armored metal, worn brass edge highlights and small amber/orange lamps. Avoid dashboard cards, rounded bubbly corners, top or bottom full-screen borders, noisy decals, excessive glowing surfaces, cropped columns.
Concept direction: Closest to current Armored Command: continuous paired armored pillars, heavy square gunmetal frames, octagonal corner bolts, worn olive-brass bevels, restrained molten-orange seam lights, vertically stacked sturdy wells. Clear continuous outer silhouette.

concepts.name: Split Batteries
concepts.direction: A distinct modular arrangement: each specified screen well is an independent squared armored instrument pod. Small dark metal links connect the pods to one very slim outer spine; transparent gaps separate modules. Crisp blackened steel, bright worn brass corner blocks and short orange indicators. The two square maneuver bays and two square stock bays read as distinct detachable cartridges. Keep exact screen layout.

concepts.name: Tactical Rails
concepts.direction: The lightest and clearest Armored Command derivative: thin double-edged chrome and black steel rails around each specified screen, very small amber bolts and orange status slits, broad unobstructed dark display wells. Narrow structural side bars and open transparent gaps make this feel like a precise fighter instrument rack. Square geometry and original arcade metal finish, no blue futuristic holograms.

concepts.name: Siege Console
concepts.direction: Brutal tank-like Armored Command: strongly squared fortress frames with layered deep gunmetal armor, orange warning lamps inset at corners, chipped brass inner bevel, vented exterior edge pieces. Large dramatic stock-counter sockets and radar armor without intruding into the defined wells. Distinct reinforced industrial style, restrained wear and high-contrast bevel clusters.

concepts.name: Command Glass
concepts.direction: A polished late Neo-Geo military arcade console: slim faceted graphite metal and pale brushed-steel inner lips around flat opaque navy display wells, subdued brass screws and a few vivid warm orange lamps. Large visually calm rectangular and square display surfaces with less physical bulk than Bastion. Several separated framing blocks on a thin backplate. No transparent or glossy reflections inside wells, no holograms, no rounded mobile-app card look.
